subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should paired-node Claude continuation use a private admin-gated catalog runner, or become a supported generic plugin/node invocation contract?
rationale: The choice defines a new remote execution and plugin API boundary, including which operator scope may create node-bound sessions; repository policy and existing contracts do not safely resolve that product and authorization decision automatically.

options.title: Private admin-gated runner
options.body: Keep the Claude runner out of generic invocableCommands, require operator.admin for node-bound catalog adoption, and expose only the dedicated continuation seam.

options.title: Public generic runner contract
options.body: Explicitly approve and document a generic plugin API for streaming agent runs, with consistent invocation, authorization, compatibility tests, and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Pause paired-node continuation
options.body: Retain paired-node catalog rows as view-only until a smaller reusable agent-run protocol and security model are designed.

recommendation.title: Private admin-gated runner
recommendation.body: Keep the Claude runner out of generic invocableCommands, require operator.admin for node-bound catalog adoption, and expose only the dedicated continuation seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The current session-catalog and paired-node continuation design appears to be led by their recent merged and proposed work in this area.
